reviewer: Codex direct engineering review; not a clinician
scope: Fourteen synthetic scenarios per language, including two fixed emergency replies. Small development sample, not a clinical benchmark or general-model ranking.
freshness: Candidate holdout was unseen on its first run; after fixing discovered filter/routing defects, the repeated run is regression evidence.
code_note: The twelve earlier reviewed scenarios preceded the final indirect-danger and lexical-filter fixes; the sixteen holdout regressions use those fixes. Draft generation and review prompts are unchanged between these runs.

decision: English meets the experimental language criterion. Turkish remains available with the owner-specified strong warning. Resource and real HTTP integration checks passed. Approved for bounded local demonstration only; provider integration and final owner acceptance remain pending.
